I found the task pane component and applied the fix.

**File changed:** `src/components/tabs/TaskTab.tsx`

**Change:** The task pane's sub-tab state (`"diff" | "chat" | "console"`) was initialized to `"diff"` (the VFS Diff view). I changed the default to `"chat"`:

```tsx
const [taskSubTab, setTaskSubTab] = useState<"diff" | "chat" | "console">("chat");
```

Now whenever a task pane is opened (via a task node in the canvas), it will always land on the **Prompt Chat** tab first, rather than the **VFS Diff** tab. The console/log tab default and all other tab-switching behavior (clicking tabs, footer controls, editor layout-on-active logic) remain unchanged — only the initial tab selected on open was affected.

I also reviewed `Workspace.tsx` and `AgentTab.tsx` to confirm there isn't a second, separate "task pane" implementation with its own description/diff/chat tab state — `TaskTab.tsx` is the only component matching that description (Diff / Prompt Chat / Console Stream tabs), so this single change covers the request.
